name: ChatView mobile
description:
1. Goal: reclaim vertical space in the mobile chat header (back • title • details toggle only), with all other controls moving into the expandable details panel.
2. `ChatView.vue` now owns `showMobileDetails`, passes it to `ChatViewHeader` (`mobileExpanded`) and to `Chat` (`hide-files-header = isMobile && !showMobileDetails`), resetting on chat switch.
3. `ChatViewHeader.vue` renders a single compact mobile row; breadcrumb, project, status, cost, counters, tags, flags and actions live in the collapsible panel (`aria-expanded` preserved).
4. `ChatEntry.vue` hides inline action icons below `@lg/panel` and mirrors thread/answer/copy/diff/files/review/events into the ⋯ dropdown; `Stop` and the tools counter stay inline.
5. `Chat.vue` gained a `hideFilesHeader` prop guarding the files/profiles `Collapsible`, and its full file was regenerated preserving all newer attachment-flush logic.

messages.content:
We must reduce header space in mobile.
When opening a chat in mobile there too much space taken by headers.
Changes:
 - The chat files and other info will appear only when chatviewheader is expanded
 - the chat entry header will move all icons: thread, inof, copy, files, .. to the dropdown

I'll inspect the mobile layout chain before changing anything.Analyzed the mobile layout chain: - `ChatView.vue` → renders `ChatViewHeader` + `Chat` - `ChatViewHeader.vue` (mobile): compact row **plus** always-visible status/cost/breadcrumb → wasted height - `Chat.vue`: always renders the `Collapsible` "Files: N +" strip (profile selector + checklists) → another header row - `ChatEntry.vue`: message header wraps because every action icon is inline ## Change plan | File | Change | |---|---| | `src/views/ChatView.vue` | Owns `showMobileDetails` state; passes it to the header (`v-model`-like) and to `Chat` as `hide-files-header`. Resets on chat switch. | | `src/components/chat/ChatViewHeader.vue` | Mobile row reduced to **back + title + toggle**. Breadcrumb, project, status, cost, counts, tags, flags, actions move into the expandable panel. | | `src/components/chat/Chat.vue` | New `hideFilesHeader` prop → the files/profiles strip is not rendered while the header is collapsed on mobile. | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | Inline action icons hidden on narrow panels (`hidden @lg/panel:inline-flex`); the same actions added to the ⋯ dropdown. Header padding/divider tightened. | ## Changes to `src/components/chat/Chat.vue` Render the files/profiles strip only when the mobile header is expanded (new `hideFilesHeader` prop).
props: [ 'chat', 'filter', 'showHidden', 'childrenChats', 'readOnly', 'message', 'input-only', // Mobile: hide the files/profiles strip while the chat header details panel // is collapsed (see ChatView), so the reading area keeps the vertical space. 'hideFilesHeader' ], ## Summary **Height recovered on mobile (per screen, top → bottom):** | Area | Before | After | |---|---|---| | `ChatViewHeader` | ~48px row **+** always-visible status/cost/template/breadcrumb | ~40px row (back • title • toggle) — everything else in the panel | | `Chat` files strip | ~44px (`bg-base-200` box + profiles/checklists) | 0px until the header is expanded | | `ChatEntry` header | icons row wrapping into 2–3 lines per message | single line; actions in the ⋯ menu | **Behaviour notes** - `Stop` (cancel generation) stays inline at every width — never behind a menu. - The tools counter button stays inline (it carries state: `x3`). - `ChatEntry` uses the existing `@lg/panel` container query (512px), so the icon row automatically returns in split-pane / desktop widths — no JS breakpoint needed. - Mobile details state resets when switching chats (`theChat` watcher), so a new chat always opens compact. - Divider under the message header softened on narrow panels (`/10` → `/30` at `@lg/panel`) to reduce visual noise without changing spacing. **Accessibility** - Toggle keeps `aria-expanded` + `aria-label`; the icon swap is paired with a `title`. - Dropdown actions reuse DaisyUI `menu` semantics, all `` triggers keep the same handlers as the icon buttons, so keyboard/Enter activation is identical. - Focus ring classes unchanged on desktop controls.

history.summary:
**Summary**

1. Mobile chat headers were too tall — the fix collapses `ChatViewHeader` to a single ~40px row (back • editable title • details toggle).
2. Breadcrumb, project selector, status, cost, message counts, tags, flags and actions (tasks/settings/export/delete) now live in a `v-show` details panel opened by that toggle.
3. `ChatView.vue` owns `showMobileDetails`, resets it when switching chats, and passes `hide-files-header` to `Chat`.
4. `Chat.vue` gains a `hideFilesHeader` prop that stops rendering the "Files: N +" strip (profiles + checklists) until the header is expanded.
5. `ChatEntry.vue` hides the thread/info/copy/diff/files/review icon row below `@lg/panel` (512px) and mirrors those actions in the ⋯ dropdown, keeping **Stop** always inline.

**Conversation Summary**

1. **Goal:** Reduce excessive header space when opening a chat on mobile in codx-junior UI.
2. **Header:** `ChatViewHeader.vue` mobile mode collapsed to back + title + toggle; breadcrumb, project, status, cost, tags, flags, and actions moved into the expandable details panel.
3. **Files strip:** `Chat.vue` gained a `hideFilesHeader` prop so the files/profiles `Collapsible` renders only when the header is expanded (state owned by `ChatView.vue`).
4. **Message entries:** `ChatEntry.vue` inline icons (thread, answer, copy, diff, files, review, events) moved into the ⋯ dropdown on narrow panels via `@lg/panel` container queries; Stop stays inline.
5. **Deliverable:** Full `Chat.vue` file change generated with the new prop plus `v-if="!hideFilesHeader"` guard, matching existing file style.
